config.autoplacelight.title: Auto Place Light
config.autoplacelight.checkWalls.tooltip: Require a line of sight to a location before placing.
config.autoplacelight.horizontalRadius.t: How far to search horizontally in blocks.
config.autoplacelight.verticalRadius.too: How far to search vertically in blocks.
config.autoplacelight.lightLevel.tooltip: Lights will be placed whenever the light level is at or below this value.

config.autoplacelight.placeItem.tooltip: Item id's of the items to place. Accepts tags(#) and wild cards(*).
